title: Pronunciation and Vocabulary (Theme 7: Safety)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 English; not yet checked by a Kenyan English teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child listens for the whole sound group (dw, tw, nk, sq), not only the first letter, and picks the word that has it.

floor.prerequisite: Hears the first sound of a word.
floor.question: Does "sink" start like "sing"?

steps: Say the target sound alone, then in words.
Say two words that differ by one sound; the child picks one.
Find the sound in a short sentence.
contexts: a bank on a busy street

board.do: Wait for the child to point.
The child circles the word that was said and says it back.

misconceptions.ask: Did you hear a click at the end?
Did the lips round after k?

checks.question: Which word starts like squeeze: square, school, sun?
Which word ends with nk: thing, think, tin?
